minutes.headline: Select Board kept old primary school and senior tax relief as FY22 goals; granted entertainment license and ratified hires.
minutes.summary: First in-person meeting in about 14 months. The board approved a weekday entertainment license for Smokestack Roasters, ratified a police officer and a senior videographer, and heard the Council on Aging report. A long goals workshop kept the old primary school and a senior property tax exemption by home rule petition, and added a volunteer-recruitment policy. The board discussed pay-as-you-throw bags for seniors, ARPA funds and a much higher Flat Hill culvert estimate, then went into executive session on the town manager's contract.

public_comment.topic: Chair invited public comment at the start; none offered.
A resident said the board is dancing around the old primary school and should request its demolition and focus on rehabbing town hall and the Ritter building.

what_happened.line: The Select Board kept the old primary school as a FY22 goal, reworded, and asked for a July workshop with the architectural preservation district.
The board added senior property tax relief, by home rule petition, as a top FY22 goal; it would need town meeting approval.
The board approved a weekday entertainment license for Smokestack Roasters after the chair withdrew his proposal to limit hours.
The board ratified the town manager's appointments of a full-time police officer and a senior videographer.
The board heard that pay-as-you-throw bag sales ran ahead of estimates and that senior bag relief will return as an agenda item.

why_it_matters: A senior property tax exemption by home rule petition would be a vote at town meeting, and it changes who carries the tax levy.
The old primary school and the reuse of town hall and the Ritter building stay unresolved, so the town still carries them as open building and cost questions.
watch_next: A July workshop with the architectural preservation district on the old primary school.
Senior pay-as-you-throw bag relief, to return as an agenda item once data is gathered.
